node.title: XR high-band windowed-projection reduction: exact projective multiplicity identity, high-depth injectivity, and averaged window inequality
node.statement: For every tangent-gate Reed-Solomon pencil and every depth ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, let N_d^raw count all depth-d joint-explanation pairs, W_d(z) count codewords with agreement in [k+d,A-2] at member z, and beta_d=floor((n-k-d)/(h-d-1)). Then (q+1-beta_d)N_d^raw <= sum_z W_d(z). Hence the selected occupancy N_d obeys the same bound, and 25 sum_z W_d(z) <= 17n^2(q+1-beta_d) implies N_d<=17n^2/25. The proof is the exact P^1 cell identity sum_z(a_P(z)-k-d)=n-k-d, the beta over-agreement packing bound, and injectivity of P->pi_z(P) when 2d>=h. This is a reduction only; it does not assert the high-window list estimate.
